milestones.next: Continue to maintain links, accessibility and source attribution.

milestones.title: Biblical primary-text collection
milestones.delivered: Local Bible reader, named-reference index and 26 original guides with explicit passage references.
milestones.next: Add careful textual comparison and qualified specialist review where applicable.

milestones.title: Encyclopaedia expansion and preservation
milestones.delivered: Expanded the original collection with 14 specialist-sourced, independently authored historical guides covering eight rulers, governance, deportation, religion, languages, the imperial collapse and later regional history. Added 56 section-level reading trails, 10 source records and dated timeline routes. Earlier preserved reference corpus, glossary and measured growth dashboard remain available. Added another eight original language and heritage studies without importing unlicensed texts.
milestones.next: Continue article depth with exact inscription-line and tablet comparisons, fuller Middle Assyrian history, provincial life, women and non-elite voices, plus better dated post-imperial regional evidence. Specialist peer review remains outstanding.

milestones.title: Interactive historical atlas
milestones.delivered: The interactive historical atlas has eleven dated teaching stages with preserved offline basemap data, timeline playback, modern geography and city context. Milestone 3 adds chapter-specific reconstruction limits, source-by-source scope notes, clearer differentiation of provincial control from vassalage or temporary military reach, 21 linked historical and biblical reading routes, and checks that keep map citations and article links current.
milestones.next: Continue specialist cartographic and historical review before refining polygon coordinates. Map individual provinces only when dated inscriptional, administrative and archaeological evidence supports them. Test real browser behaviour, reduced-motion support and mobile readability. No numerical border certainty or ancient area estimates are justified.

milestones.title: Section-level source traceability
milestones.delivered: Evidence Register, bidirectional source-to-guide links and 189 section-level reading trails across 63 original guides, including 32 newly mapped language and manuscript sections.
milestones.next: Extend remaining section coverage and claim-specific review without treating a mapped bibliography as independent historical verification.

milestones.title: Historical claim verification
milestones.delivered: Initial 15 text-anchored claim records with direct passages, source roles, qualifications and an independent-review queue.
milestones.next: Check precise inscription and tablet identifiers, compare royal texts with biblical passages and document named specialist review. Newly added historical articles are section-mapped, not claim-level peer reviewed.

milestones.title: Assyrian languages and cultural heritage
milestones.delivered: Added eight original specialist-sourced guides with 32 section reading trails on cuneiform interpretation, Syriac manuscript hands and Unicode, local NENA dialects, Urmi documentation, Surayt and ethical recording. A new navigable language reference room presents 22 Unicode-identified Syriac letters, links to HMML manuscript lessons and Cambridge field recordings for Urmi, Alqosh and Ankawa. No third-party audio or protected manuscript images are copied.
milestones.next: Invite qualified speakers and palaeographers to review word forms and transcriptions, then add permission-cleared dialect-labelled pronunciation samples and transliteration conventions. Test Syriac font rendering across devices. Do not claim one universal pronunciation or conflate Akkadian with Neo-Aramaic.

milestones.title: Community testimony and heritage media
milestones.delivered: Local Markdown contribution drafts can be downloaded without transmitting personal data.
milestones.next: Plan speaker-consented dialect recordings, oral histories and family/village heritage submissions with permission and withdrawal controls before publishing or distributing audio.

milestones.title: Secure contribution delivery

milestones.next: Authorise a project-specific sender or Microsoft Graph integration, then verify privacy, anti-abuse controls and genuine end-to-end delivery.

milestones.title: Editorial governance and revision history
milestones.delivered: Contributor guidance and deterministic metadata validation exist.
milestones.next: Define named reviewers, corrections, record revision provenance, moderation and multilingual editorial workflows.

milestones.title: Publication and long-term stewardship
milestones.delivered: Static deployment, offline validation and explicit indexing controls are established.
milestones.next: Complete independent specialist linguistic and historical review, script rendering, accessibility and cross-browser testing, rights checks and deliberate indexing approval.
